relevance_note: National epidemiological survey of A20 haploinsufficiency in Japan: the authors state 'All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3' and give every patient an individual label (P1-P54) with variant, sex, age at onset, treatment and clinical features.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema, the rules and the instructions file; the file was written by hand and every span was copied character by character from the paper and checked against it. Values come from Supplementary Table 1 (label, family, sex, age at onset, genotype, previous/current treatment and the per-patient 'reference' column, copied into source_reference_in_review) and Supplementary Table 2 (per-patient clinical features); Table 1, Table 2 and the Results text were used for cohort-level facts and for the patients the text names. Spans are the shortest fragment that supports the value: the printed cell for table cells, the printed row fragment for the identifying fields, and the printed phrase for text statements. The paper prints no legend defining '-' or the minus sign in Supplementary Table 2, so those cells are 'not reported' and never 'excluded' (D-22 table symbols). Bare '+' cells are counted as present because the number of '+' cells equals the paper's stated counts: recurrent fever 46 of 54 and recurrent stomatitis 42 of 54 (both match Table 2 exactly), cutaneous symptoms 26 '+' cells plus patient 10's 'BCG dermatitis' = the 27 stated, autoimmune disease 15 (matching Table 2's breakdown: Hashimoto's 8, Graves' 1, SLE 3, SS 2, AIH 3, AIHA and ITP 1, psoriatic arthritis 1, type 1 diabetes 1), lymphadenopathy 8, and the type I IFN score column gives 16 'Elevated' and 3 'Normal', exactly the text's '16 patients had an elevated IFN score and three patients ... exhibited IFN levels within the normal range'. Two checks: the genital '+' cells number 20 against Table 2's 'Genital ulcer | 19 (35.2)' (one patient more than the stated count; the oral '+' cells number 42 and do match 'Recurrent stomatitis | 42 (77.8)'), and the Musculoskeletal column gives 20 patients with arthritis or arthralgia, as 'Musculoskeletal symptoms | 20 (37.0)' states. Central nervous system involvement is marked observed only for the five patients the text names (10, 33, 38, 44, 47); patients whose only neurological entry is 'Headache', 'core ataxia' or 'psychiatric symptoms' were left not reported. 'Graves’ disease' (patient 17) was not counted as autoimmune thyroiditis; 'AIH susp' (patient 53) was not counted as autoimmune hepatitis; IgA vasculitis (patients 12, 36 and 39) was counted as vasculitis. The checklist item 'elevated inflammatory markers (CRP/ESR)' is 'not reported' for every individual, because the paper reports CRP only as group averages ('an average C-reactive protein (CRP) level of 7.89 mg/dl'); the per-patient IFN-score result is instead recorded in phenotypic_features as 'elevated IFN score' (observed) or, for the three patients with 'Normal', as excluded under D-27. 'recurrent infections' and 'growth failure' are not reported for everyone. phenotypic_features lists the findings named in Supplementary Table 2's musculoskeletal, cutaneous, autoimmune and 'Others/medical history' cells plus the IFN-score result and the features the Results text states for named patients; the composite cells 'Recurrent / fever', 'Ulcer / (oral/ / genital)' and 'Intestinal / symptoms' are represented in phenotype_checklist only. Contradictions and inconsistencies in the paper: (1) the Methods minigene paragraph prints 'c.986+1G>T' while Supplementary Table 1, Supplementary Table 2 and Supplementary Figure 1 print 'c.986+1G>C' for patient 50 (the patient's own string was kept); (2) patient 45 is printed 'p.L324QsfsX' in Supplementary Table 1 and 'p.Leu324GlnfsX7' in Supplementary Figure 1 (the Supplementary Table 1 string was used). variant_type_as_stated is 'splice' only where the paper states it for that variant (the four variants called splice-site variants in the Methods, i.e. patients 30 and 32-35 and 49; the 'exon 8 skipping' sentence for patients 3 and 49; the c.986+1G>C minigene result for patient 50) and 'large deletion/CNV' only where the printed genotype itself states a deletion (patients 24, 27, 28, 38, 54); for the other patients the paper states no class, so it is 'not reported' (D-29 forbids deriving the class from the HGVS string). zygosity 'heterozygous' for P1-P54 comes from the named-group sentence 'All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3'; inheritance, ACMG criteria, functional evidence and pathogenicity are 'not reported' because the paper's variant statements are cohort-level ('35 distinct pathogenic variants') or list several values. parental_testing_statement is filled for patients 3 and 18 only, from the sentence that a parent carries low-frequency somatic mosaicism of TNFAIP3 in peripheral blood; the variant the parent carries is not identified, so inheritance stays 'not reported'. The two low-frequency somatic mosaicism individuals (p.Q760X and c.806-1G>T) are reported as not having HA20 and are not relatives of an in-scope person, so they got no rows; the mother of patient 3 and the father of patient 18 are in scope as relatives of patients and are recorded with zygosity 'mosaic'; the three asymptomatic heterozygous relatives ('three cases with heterozygous variants were asymptomatic') are not described individually, so they got no rows. disease_label_as_stated is the initial diagnosis printed for that patient in Supplementary Table 2, not the paper's disease name. 'Kawasaki disease' and 'PFAPA' are medical history, not 'recurrent infections'. HPO candidate labels and identifiers were left null because no match was certain. is_proband is false with no span because the paper never uses the words proband or index case. Deviation to note: the fields status and evidence_basis were left with span null throughout phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist, because the supporting quote is already carried by the same row's feature_text_as_stated (phenotypic_features) or by the Supplementary Table 2 cell the item is read from (phenotype_checklist, whose checklist_feature span is null by the instructions); no value in those two fields goes beyond what the row's quoted evidence says.
